ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two inputs X and Y, and the output is Z. In the upper branch, X first passes through an inverter, and the inverted signal is sent into the upper AND gate; Y is directly sent into the other input terminal of the same upper AND gate. In the lower branch, X is directly sent into the lower AND gate; after Y passes through an inverter, it is sent into the other input terminal of the lower AND gate. The outputs of the two AND gates are then sent together into the OR gate on the right side, and the output of the OR gate is Z. Then reason: The output of the upper AND gate is X'Y; the output of the lower AND gate is XY'. These two terms are ORed at the output terminal, so Z = X'Y + XY'. This Boolean expression is exactly the standard form of XOR logic, so the equivalent circuit is XOR gate.

再推理：上方 AND 门输出为 X'Y；下方 AND 门输出为 XY'。这两个项在输出端被 OR 起来，所以 Z = X'Y + XY'。该布尔表达式正是异或逻辑的标准形式，因此等效电路是 XOR gate。

method.method_draft: Describe the circuit connections from the image, then evaluate Z for all four input cases. For X,Y = 00, both AND branches are 0 so Z=0; for 01, the upper branch NOT X AND Y is 1 so Z=1; for 10, the lower branch X AND NOT Y is 1 so Z=1; for 11, both branches are blocked by the inverters so Z=0. The truth table 0,1,1,0 corresponds to an XOR gate.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中输入 X 分成两路，其中一路先经过反相器再进入上方 AND 门；输入 Y 直接进入上方 AND 门，所以上方支路为 NOT X AND Y。另一组支路中，X 直接进入下方 AND 门，Y 先经过反相器再进入下方 AND 门，所以下方支路为 X AND NOT Y。两个 AND 门的输出再输入到右侧 OR 门，输出为 Z。再推理：Z = (NOT X AND Y) OR (X AND NOT Y)。逐项计算：X,Y=00 时两条 AND 支路都为 0，Z=0；01 时 NOT X AND Y=1，Z=1；10 时 X AND NOT Y=1，Z=1；11 时两条支路都因反相输入为 0，Z=0。真值表为 0,1,1,0，这正是 XOR 的真值表。
